capabilities: Display data in various views (board, calendar, gallery, etc.).
Implement slash commands for database interaction.
disambiguation: Not a Notion sync service; it reuses Obsidian's local Markdown storage format.
extras: Everything stays plain markdown. There is no lock-in, no sync service, and no account. Charts are drawn locally as SVG.
problem: Users are limited by proprietary database formats and lack advanced visualization tools like boards and rollups in standard Markdown note-taking apps.
summary: Notion Suite provides Notion-style databases, including boards, calendars, and charts, within Obsidian using local Markdown files.
